methods.label: Rational-number division
methods.explanation: Dividing 0 by any nonzero number gives 0. \((-8)\div(-2)=4\); \(6\div(-1/3)=6\times(-3)=-18\); the divisor cannot be 0.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 division rules, signed multiplication, and reciprocals.
